dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Aderfi has a lot of nice stuff that you can't find or trade, and people like to go there to do business.

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Y'know, to get things like... gadgets, toys, new clothes... and cosmetics...

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: What do you even mean by that? Lapis lazuli eye shadow is an essential sunscreen for us desert folk, and we can use concealer to hide scars. Makeup's super useful!
